intro.text: MELOVME is born from a simple belief — caring for yourself is an act of love. Every product blends nature's finest ingredients with a touch of luxury, so your daily ritual feels personal, soft and unmistakably you.

gifting.imageAlt: MELOVME gift box, velvet pouch and message card
gifting.title:
Wrapped in chocolate,

finished in gold.
gifting.text: Every MELOVME gift arrives in a textured keepsake box with botanical gold-foil detailing, a soft velvet pouch and a personal message card — ready to make someone feel loved.

meta.description: The story behind MELOVME — premium body care built around self-love.

hero.title: Me. <shimmer>Love.</shimmer> Me.
hero.text: Our name says it all. MELOVME is a reminder to pause, care for yourself, and celebrate the person you are — one soft, fragrant ritual at a time.

whoWeAre.imageAlt: MELOVME Body Lotion among fresh leaves and jasmine
whoWeAre.title: Premium care, rooted in nature.
whoWeAre.paragraph1: MELOVME is a premium body-care identity built around the idea of self-love and personal care. We believe that the products you reach for every day should feel just as special as the moments you save them for.
whoWeAre.paragraph2: Our signature droplet represents what we stand for — skincare, hydration and nourishment. Our warm chocolate and soft ivory tones reflect the natural, sophisticated experience we bring to every bottle and box.

journey.title: From an idea to your signature

idea.text: The idea of MELOVME is born — body care that celebrates self-love.

formulation.text: Months of formulation and testing to perfect our signature lotion.

next.text: New rituals and fragrances to complete your signature collection.
